name: Flor de Caña rum
about: Flor de Caña is Nicaragua's well-known aged rum, made in the country and sold widely in Managua. It is a classic gift from the city.
tip: Choose between the 7-year and 12-year versions; the 12-year is aged longer and costs more.

name: Nicaraguan coffee
where: Casa del Café or Café Las Flores
about: Nicaragua grows coffee in its highland farms, and Managua's cafés sell local beans as a taste of the country's coffee culture.
tip: Check the price in US dollars before you buy, since that is the currency many shops use for pricing.
